pageTitle: Chotta Bheem Play Date — Back to Roots

program.title: Chotta Bheem Play Date
program.description: Embark on action-packed adventures inspired by our beloved Chhota Bheem's world of courage and friendship. Engage in traditional Indian games, storytelling, and creative activities that build character and confidence.
program.imageAlt: Children enjoying Chotta Bheem themed activities

items.title: Bheem's Strength Training
items.description: Fun physical activities inspired by Bheem's adventures - obstacle courses, team challenges, and strength-building games.

items.title: Laddu Making Workshop
items.description: Create healthy, traditional laddus just like Bheem's favorites using natural ingredients and learn about nutritious eating.

items.title: Character Role Play
items.description: Act out favorite Chotta Bheem stories, develop storytelling skills, and learn about friendship, courage, and helping others.

items.title: Bheem's Art Corner
items.description: Draw and paint Chotta Bheem characters, create story boards, and make take-home crafts inspired by Dholakpur adventures.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Play clothes, water bottle, snack box

items.label: Take home
items.value: Handmade laddus, character drawings, Bheem storybook
